title: Langley incursions and Goldwater Range flashing lights videos
place_text: Langley AFB, Virginia; Goldwater Training Range, Arizona

tellings.quote: um the Langley incursions. If you there's a there's witness video where the guy zooms out and you can see I don't know 10 15 flashing light

plain: A guest on Jesse Michels's podcast named Merrick talks about the Langley incursions, reports of unknown objects entering the airspace over Langley Air Force Base in Virginia in the 2020s, along with videos from the Goldwater Range, a military training area in Arizona. Merrick says there is witness video where the person filming zooms out and you can see maybe 10 or 15 flashing lights. If true, it would mean groups of unexplained objects were operating over US military sites.
